nodes.description: Ownable.owner: privileged address controlling contract administration.
BaseWallet._owner: wallet owner used by modules for authorization.
BaseWallet.modules: mapping of authorized module addresses.
BaseWallet.controller: controller holding registries and factory address.
BaseWallet.methodToModule: selector to module binding used by fallback dispatch.
ReentrancyGuard._guardValue: reentrancy lock flag.
MetaTxAware.trustedForwarder: address allowed to append meta-tx sender data.
WalletFactory.walletImplementation: logic contract used by new proxies.
WalletFactory.DOMAIN_SEPERATOR: EIP712 domain hash for signed requests.
WalletFactory.blanks: pre-deployed blank proxy to module-set version mapping.
AddressSet.sets: key to address set storage used by stores.
HashStore.hashes: consumed request hashes per wallet.
NonceStore.nonces: highest used meta-tx nonce per wallet.
QuotaStore.quotas: per-wallet rolling spending quota state.
QuotaStore.defaultQuota: fallback quota applied when none is scheduled.
SecurityStore.wallets: guardian, lock and inheritor state per wallet.
WhitelistStore.effectiveTimeMap: whitelist activation timestamp per address.
Controller.moduleRegistry: registry used to validate modules.
Controller.walletRegistry: registry of created wallets.
Controller.walletFactory: address allowed to initialize wallets.
Claimable.pendingOwner: two-step ownership transfer target.
BaseENSManager.ensResolver: resolver contract used for forward/reverse ENS.
msg.sender: external caller used for all authorization checks.
block.timestamp: miner-controllable time used for locks, quotas and whitelists.
Raw low-level value call to arbitrary address in AddressUtil.sendETH.
Arbitrary delegatecall executed in BaseWallet.nonReentrantCall (mode 2).
Raw module.call forwarded with msg.data and msg.value in BaseWallet.fallback.
Assembly delegatecall to implementation in Proxy.fallback.
staticcall to an arbitrary signer contract in SignatureUtil.verifyERC1271Signature.
create2 deployment of user-controllable bytecode in Create2.deploy.
Unchecked set.count += 1 in AddressSet.addAddressToSet.
Unchecked set.count -= 1 in AddressSet.removeAddressFromSet.
Unchecked uint128 arithmetic and mul/sub decay math in QuotaStore.spentQuota and addToSpent.
External Module(_module).activate()/deactivate() callbacks performed by the wallet.
AddressSet.addAddressToSet: inserts an address in a maintained set, incrementing count.
AddressSet.removeAddressFromSet: swap-and-pop removal, decrementing count.
Ownable.transferOwnership: onlyOwner ownership handover.
Claimable.claimOwnership: pendingOwner finalizes ownership transfer.
BaseWallet.setOwner: module-only owner change on the wallet.
BaseWallet.transact: module/factory-only generic call performed by the wallet.
BaseWallet.nonReentrantCall: private call/delegatecall/staticcall dispatcher guarded by nonReentrant.
BaseWallet.fallback: dispatches calldata to bound module based on msg.sig.
BaseWallet.addModuleInternal: registers and activates a module.
BaseWallet.removeModule: deletes a module and calls deactivate.
BaseWallet.setController: module-only controller replacement.
BaseWallet.initOwner: factory-only one-time owner initialization.
BaseWallet.initController: one-time controller initialization.
HashStore.verifyAndUpdate: consumes a signed request hash, module-only.
NonceStore.verifyAndUpdate: advances a wallet nonce, module-only.
QuotaStore.addToSpent: increases spent amount and stamps timestamp.
QuotaStore.changeQuota: schedules a new quota for a wallet, module-only.
QuotaStore.checkAndAddToSpent: enforces quota before spending.
SecurityStore.setLock: module-only timed wallet lock.
SecurityStore.touchLastActive: refreshes wallet activity timestamp.
SecurityStore.addGuardian: module-only guardian insertion with downcasting.
SecurityStore.cleanRemovedGuardians: prunes expired guardians from storage.
WhitelistStore.addToWhitelist: module-only whitelist insertion with effective time.
WhitelistStore.isWhitelisted: timestamp-based whitelist effectiveness check.
DappAddressStore.addDapp: manager-only dapp whitelisting.
DappAddressStore.removeDapp: manager-only dapp removal.
OwnerManagable.addManager: owner-only manager addition.
WalletFactory.createWallet: payable deployment of a new wallet from a signed request.
WalletFactory.createWallet2: wallet creation consuming a pre-deployed blank.
WalletFactory.validateRequest_: EIP712 signature and meta-tx hash validation.
WalletFactory.deploy_: CREATE2 proxy deployment plus controller/module setup.
WalletFactory.initializeWallet_: sets owner, registers wallet and ENS.
WalletFactory.registerENS_: forwards ENS registration and optional reverse record.
SimpleProxy.setImplementation: one-time logic address setter.
SimpleProxy.implementation: reads logic address from assembly slot.
AddressUtil.sendETH: value transfer with user-supplied gas limit.
AddressUtil.fastCall: assembly call transferring value with arbitrary data.
AddressUtil.fastCallAndVerify: fastCall with revert-on-failure.
MathUint.mul: checked multiplication helper.
MathUint.sub: checked subtraction helper.
MathUint.add: checked addition helper.
SafeCast.toUint128: downcast with bounds require.
MetaTxAware.msgSender: logical sender derived from trusted forwarder calldata.
MetaTxAware.txAwareHash: hash appended to forwarded calldata.
BaseENSManager.register: manager-only subdomain registration.
BaseENSManager.verifyApproval: recovers signer from approval and checks manager role.
SignatureUtil.verifyERC1271Signature: staticcall to contract signer wallet.
SignatureUtil.recoverECDSASigner: ecrecover with malleability bound on s.
ENSConsumer.getENSRegistry: returns configured ENS registry.
Proxy.fallback: assembly delegatecall to implementation address.
Parameter addr of addAddressToSet.
Parameter key of addAddressToSet.
Storage pointer set in addAddressToSet.

edges.reason: Ownable constructor assigns the owner state variable from msg.sender.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender against owner before transferOwnership executes.
transferOwnership writes the privileged owner state variable.
onlyPendingOwner modifier compares msg.sender against pendingOwner.
claimOwnership promotes pendingOwner and clears it.
onlyFromModule checks modules[msg.sender] before setOwner.
setOwner writes the wallet _owner state variable.
onlyFromFactoryOrModule validates msg.sender before transact executes arbitrary calls.
BaseWallet.fallback resolves the module from msg.sig and validates msg.sender membership.
initOwner is restricted by onlyFromFactory using msg.sender against controller.walletFactory().
initOwner writes the initial _owner of the wallet.
initController is unauthenticated and only protected by one-time initialization state.
initController writes the wallet controller reference.
HashStore.verifyAndUpdate is gated by onlyWalletModule(msg.sender).
Consumed hash is stored in the hashes mapping to prevent replay.
NonceStore.verifyAndUpdate is gated by onlyWalletModule(msg.sender).
Nonce update writes nonces[wallet].
onlyWalletModule gate protects addToSpent.
onlyWalletModule gate protects changeQuota.
changeQuota writes quotas[wallet].pendingQuota and pendingUntil.
checkAndAddToSpent reads quota state before allowing spending.
onlyWalletModule gate protects checkAndAddToSpent.
checkAndAddToSpent delegates spending accumulation to addToSpent.
addToSpent writes spentAmount and spentTimestamp into the quota struct.
addToSpent records uint64(block.timestamp) as the last spent time.
addToSpent performs uint128 addition of the spent amount.
addToSpent uses MathUint.add for spentQuota + amount.
setLock requires lock == 0 or lock > block.timestamp.
onlyWalletModule gate protects setLock.
setLock writes the wallet lock and lockedBy fields.
touchLastActive stores uint64(block.timestamp) as activity marker.
onlyWalletModule gate protects touchLastActive.
touchLastActive mutates the lastActive field of the wallet struct.
addGuardian pushes a guardian into wallets[wallet].guardians.
onlyWalletModule gate protects addGuardian.
addGuardian first prunes expired guardians via cleanRemovedGuardians.
addGuardian narrows group and validSince through SafeCast downcasts.
cleanRemovedGuardians swaps and pops entries in the guardian array.
addToWhitelist writes effectiveTimeMap[wallet][addr].
addToWhitelist inserts the address into the AddressSet storage.
addToWhitelist floors the effective time at block.timestamp.
onlyWalletModule gate protects addToWhitelist.
isWhitelisted compares the stored effective time against block.timestamp.
isWhitelisted reads effectiveTimeMap for the wallet address pair.
addDapp inserts the address into the DAPPS AddressSet.
removeDapp removes the address from the DAPPS AddressSet.
addManager inserts the address into the MANAGER AddressSet.
onlyManager gate protects addDapp.
onlyManager gate protects removeDapp.
onlyOwner gate protects addManager.
addAddressToSet reads and writes sets[key].
removeAddressFromSet reads and writes sets[key] positions and addresses.
addAddressToSet performs set.count += 1 without overflow protection.
removeAddressFromSet performs set.count -= 1 without underflow protection.
addModuleInternal sets modules[_module] = true.
addModuleInternal invokes the external Module(_module).activate() callback.
Module activation callback executes external code while the module flag is already written.
removeModule deletes modules[_module].
removeModule calls Module(_module).deactivate() allowing reentry before state deletion.
setController writes the wallet controller reference.
onlyFromModule on setController reads modules[msg.sender].
onlyFromModule gate on setController depends on msg.sender.
transact routes the request through nonReentrantCall.
nonReentrantCall executes an arbitrary delegatecall for mode 2.
nonReentrantCall toggles the _guardValue reentrancy lock.
The delegatecall target can re-enter guard-protected wallet functions.
BaseWallet.fallback forwards msg.data to the module through a raw call.
Fallback dispatch is not covered by the nonReentrant modifier guard value.
Proxy.fallback performs an assembly delegatecall to the implementation.
Proxy.fallback reads the implementation address before delegating.
sendETH performs a raw value call to a caller-provided address and gas limit.
fastCallAndVerify wraps fastCall and reverts on failure.
fastCall performs an assembly call transferring value to a caller-chosen target.
createWallet validates the EIP712 signed request before deploying.
createWallet deploys the wallet through deploy_.
createWallet initializes the freshly deployed wallet.
createWallet2 validates the signed request before consuming a blank.
createWallet2 deploys or consumes a blank proxy.
createWallet2 initializes the resulting wallet.
validateRequest_ hashes the request with DOMAIN_SEPERATOR.
validateRequest_ compares txAwareHash() with the computed signHash.
deploy_ uses Create2.deploy with the SimpleProxy creation code.
deploy_ sets the proxy implementation from walletImplementation.
deploy_ calls initController on the new wallet proxy.
deploy_ adds each requested module through addModuleInternal.
initializeWallet_ calls initOwner on the wallet.
initializeWallet_ forwards to registerENS_ when a label is supplied.
initializeWallet_ reads controller.walletRegistry() to register the wallet.
registerENS_ calls ensManager.register which is manager-restricted.
register uses and updates records through ensResolver.
register verifies the manager approval signature before writing ENS state.
verifyApproval recovers the ECDSA signer from the approval bytes.
verifyERC1271Signature performs a staticcall to the signer contract.
msgSender only trusts appended calldata when msg.sender equals trustedForwarder.
msgSender compares msg.sender with trustedForwarder to decide the logical sender.
msgSender falls back to the raw msg.sender for non-forwarded calls.
txAwareHash is derived from calldata only for trustedForwarder calls.
setImplementation requires implementation() to be address(0) before writing.
MathUint.sub guards the subtraction used in the spentQuota decay formula.
MathUint.mul guards the multiplication used in the spentQuota decay formula.
MathUint.add guards accumulation of the spent amount.
Caller-supplied addr parameter flows into addAddressToSet set membership.
Caller-supplied key parameter selects the set storage slot.
newOwner parameter becomes the wallet owner if module authorization passes.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter addr is only used inside addAddressToSet for set membership.
Parameter key only selects the sets[key] storage slot in addAddressToSet.
Local storage pointer set aliases the addAddressToSet storage slot.
Local pos is a transient index used only inside removeAddressFromSet.
Local success holds the raw call result inside nonReentrantCall.
Local storage pointer q aliases quotas[wallet] inside addToSpent.
Local signHash is computed and consumed only in validateRequest_.
Parameter _module is only used to enable and activate a module.
Local module is resolved from methodToModule inside BaseWallet.fallback.
Parameter guardianAddr only feeds guardian insertion logic in addGuardian.
Local storage pointer w aliases wallets[wallet] inside cleanRemovedGuardians.
Parameter newOwner is only assigned to _owner inside setOwner.
Local returnData carries the call result out of transact.
